title: An empty world
headline: This world is empty.
alt: An empty grey baseplate with a faint grid, stretching away to the horizon under a daylight sky

title: A kitty
headline: Now there's a kitty.
alt: A big ginger tabby kitty with a red collar and a gold bell sits on the grey baseplate under a daylight sky

title: Friendship tokens and a kitty shop
headline: Earn tokens. Go shopping.
idea: Friendship tokens that you get by interacting with the kitty, to spend on toys and outfits
alt: A big ginger tabby kitty in a gold crown and a bow tie sits beside a small person in an orange hoodie on the grey baseplate; a little wooden shop with a striped awning stands behind them

title: A fish on a stick
headline: Cast the fish. She pounces.
idea: A fish toy on a stick
alt: A small person in an orange hoodie holds a fishing-rod cat toy; a blue plush fish with a pink bow hangs from its line, and a big ginger tabby kitty is running to pounce on it, on the grey baseplate

title: Atom bombs and atom boxes
headline: Dodge the atom bombs.
idea: Uranium and plutonium in a box that you can tap, which gives special tokens for upgrades or skins
alt: A cartoon atom bomb with a sleepy face falls toward a dark ring on the grey baseplate; a small person in an orange hoodie steps out of the ring while a big kitty watches, the little wooden shop behind them

title: A friend for the kitty
headline: She has a friend now.
idea: Add another cat so the cat has an friend
alt: A small cream kitten with a brown face and blue eyes rubs its cheek against a big ginger tabby kitty, who purrs with her eyes shut, on a floor of big pale tiles under a blue sky with heaped white clouds

title: Parrots, seeds and atomic fruit
headline: Parrots bring seeds. Bombs mutate them.
idea: Parrots that give you seeds (pineapple, pitahaya and mangosteen), and special mutations if a nuke explodes near the plant: irradiated, Cherenkov glow, atomic
alt: A red parrot sits on a wooden perch beside a raised garden bed of pineapples, dragon fruit and small mangosteen trees, some of them mutated deep blue, acid green and jade with little atom rings, on the pale tiled plate under a blue sky

title: A home for the cats and you
headline: A home for all three of you.
idea: A place for both cats and an owner
alt: A cosy cream cottage with a timber frame, a tiled roof and a wide arched door; inside, a big ginger kitty sleeps in her round bed, a cream kitten curls up in a wicker basket, and a kid in an orange hoodie sleeps in a wooden bed
